UpstreamDrift is the implementation authority for multibody state, mocap registration,
flight physics, and analytics kernels that AffineDrift cites. This page records **what
the code fixes at one commit**, not what every article on this site assumes. All
UpstreamDrift evidence links below use the frozen revision
[`c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/tree/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15)
(re-checked 2026-11-10 against issue #5619).

AffineDrift's normative symbol layer remains
[Mathematical Notation](notation.html) and [Notation Quick Reference](notation-quick-reference.html).
Where those documents disagree with UpstreamDrift or with each other, **trust the pinned
UpstreamDrift definitions for array layout and sign when executing code**; use the site's
notation for prose on this repository only after an explicit conversion. A consolidated
NOTATION repair is tracked separately ([#5589](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/5589), PR #5633).

## Units, Gravity, and Angle Policy {#units-gravity}

| Quantity | UpstreamDrift canonical-v2 | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length, mass, time | SI (m, kg, s) | [`docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L19-L30) |
| World frame | Z-up, right-handed | [`canonical-v2.md` §1](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L27-L28) |
| Gravity | **`g = [0, 0, -9.80665]` m/s²** | [`canonical-v2.md` §1](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L28) and [`velocity_conventions.py` `CANONICAL_GRAVITY_INERTIAL`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/engine_core/velocity_conventions.py#L22-L23) |
| Dynamic state angles | Radians in `canonical-v2` `q`/`v` | [`canonical-v2.md` §1–2](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L25-L26) |
| Pose interchange (`canonical-v1`) | Intrinsic **XYZ Euler in degrees** for pelvis + joint dict in degrees | [`pose_interchange/canonical.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/pose_interchange/canonical.py#L10-L18), [`se3.py` `R = Rx·Ry·Rz`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/pose_interchange/se3.py#L45-L47) |
| OpenSim / Simscape pose import | Degrees at adapter boundary | [`cross_engine_conventions.md` §B](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/user_guide/pose_studio/cross_engine_conventions.md#L44-L52) |

Many AffineDrift articles use **`9.81`** or **radians-only** notation; do not silently equate them with UpstreamDrift arrays.

## Canonical State Layouts (V1 and V2) {#canonical-state}

**`canonical-v1`** (`CanonicalPose`, convention tag `canonical-v1`): pelvis translation (m) +
intrinsic XYZ Euler (**degrees**) + joint-angle dict (**degrees**). Velocities are out of scope;
Pose Studio materialises `v = 0` at import
([`canonical.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/pose_interchange/canonical.py#L10-L20)).

**`canonical-v2`** (frozen dynamic contract, ADR-0026): configuration `q`, velocity `v`,
acceleration `a`, metadata `convention="canonical-v2"`, `frame="world_Zup"`, `units="SI"`
([`canonical-v2.md`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L33-L36)).

For a floating base and `n_j` internal joints:

- **`q`** (length `7 + n_j`): `[base_xyz_m, quat_wxyz, joint_angles_rad…]`
- **`v`** (length `6 + n_j`): `[base_linear_world_m/s, base_angular_body_rad/s, joint_rates…]`
- **`nq = nv + 1`** because the unit quaternion is not a free tangent coordinate; integrate with
  `integrate(q, dq)`, never `q + dq`
  ([`canonical-v2.md` §2](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L38-L58)).

## Per-Engine Native vs Canonical-V2 {#per-engine-table}

Conversions run **only at the engine adapter boundary** unless noted. Low-level
`get_state()` calls that return raw `qpos`/`qvel` (MuJoCo) or Pinocchio `data` are
**not** canonical unless routed through the adapter/CC contract
([`canonical-v2.md` §3 intro](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/conventions/canonical-v2.md#L60-L66)).

| Engine | Native floating-base `q` | Native quaternion order | Native base velocity / spatial order | Converted at adapter | **Not** converted by default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **MuJoCo / MJX** | `[xyz, quat_wxyz, …]` | w-first `(w,x,y,z)` | Free-joint `qvel`: linear in **world**, angular in **body** (matches v2 base block) | Quaternion order only at pose-IO boundary; `canonical-v2` state mapping per CC-10 | Raw [`physics_engine.get_state`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/engines/physics_engines/mujoco/python/mujoco_humanoid_golf/physics_engine.py#L254-L258) returns native `qpos`/`qvel` |
| **Pinocchio** | `[xyz, quat_xyzw]` | **w-last** `(x,y,z,w)` | Free-flyer linear & angular in **body/local** frame; Jacobian native `[linear; angular]` | Reorder quaternion; rotate base linear vel/accel to world via `velocity_map` (CC-9); **restack** spatial Jacobian to `[angular; linear]` | Internal `data.q`, `data.v` until adapter export |
| **Drake** | `QuaternionFloatingJoint`: `[quat_wxyz, xyz]` or URDF RPY `[xyz, rpy]` | w-first for quaternion joint | Spatial Jacobian `[angular; linear]` in Drake native API | Base block reorder + RPY path via `se3` (CC-28) | Internal `MultibodyPlant` state vector layout |
| **JaxSim** | `[xyz, quat_wxyz, joints…]` in backend data | w-first | Backend default **mixed**: body angular + world linear at COM | Reads/writes **canonical** `[angular; linear]` base `v` via [`velocity_conventions`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/engine_core/velocity_conventions.py); see [`jaxsim_backend.py` `get_state`/`set_state`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/engines/physics_engines/jaxsim/jaxsim_backend.py#L100-L131) | Native JaxSim tape if bypassing backend wrapper |
| **MyoSuite** | MuJoCo MJCF free joint (same as MuJoCo row) | w-first | MuJoCo free-joint `qvel` pattern | Same family as MuJoCo CC-10 / MyoSuite adapter | Activation & muscle states (not part of `q`,`v` contract) |
| **OpenSim** | `FreeJoint` coordinates (often XYZ Euler) | n/a (Euler joints) | Per-coordinate speeds, **degrees** on disk | Degrees → radians at pose boundary (CC-10) | `.osim` shoulder **Y sign flips** per model |
| **Simscape** | Parameter-bus start pose, **degrees** | n/a | Pose import only (no shared v2 dynamics export) | Degrees → radians at boundary | Simulink internal states |

**Spatial Jacobian contract (suite-wide):** combined `spatial` Jacobian is **`[angular; linear]`** rows
([`engine_core/capabilities.py` `SPATIAL_JACOBIAN_ORDER`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/engine_core/capabilities.py#L28-L36)).
Pinocchio's native frame Jacobian is transposed to that order in
[`pinocchio_physics_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/engines/physics_engines/pinocchio/python/pinocchio_physics_engine.py#L551-L562).
Drake exposes the same stacking in
[`drake_physics_engine.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/engines/physics_engines/drake/python/drake_physics_engine.py#L607-L616).

**Pose Studio cross-engine table** (pelvis prefix, joint units, quaternion order):
[`cross_engine_conventions.md` §A–C](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/docs/user_guide/pose_studio/cross_engine_conventions.md#L21-L66).
MuJoCo ↔ Pinocchio quaternion swap example:
[`pinocchio_interface.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/engines/physics_engines/mujoco/python/mujoco_humanoid_golf/pinocchio_interface.py#L183-L206).

## Spatial Twist, Wrench, and Control Notation in Code {#spatial-vectors}

| Topic | UpstreamDrift canonical usage | AffineDrift site note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 6D spatial Jacobian rows | **`[ω; v]`** (angular first) | [NOTATION.md](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/NOTATION.md#L221-L224) declares `ξ = (ω, v)` but describes `V` as "Linear + angular" and `F` as "Torque + linear force", which reads as conflicting orderings |
| Floating-base `v` in canonical-v2 | World linear + **body** angular | Site articles sometimes use all-world or all-body twists without stating the split |
| Drake native spatial velocity | Often `[angular; linear]` in Jacobians; joint velocity blocks may differ | Match CC-28 adapter, not a textbook excerpt |
| Input map in dynamics | UpstreamDrift `SPEC.md` uses **`ẋ = f(x) + g(x)u`** (lowercase **g**) | AffineDrift [NOTATION.md](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/NOTATION.md) reserves **G(x)** for the input matrix and warns against lowercase `g(x)` for the map |

## World, Target, Camera, and Lab Frames {#world-frames}

UpstreamDrift simultaneously documents **several** right-handed world frames. A single
AffineDrift pass declaring "X forward, Y lateral, Z up" does not identify which of these
is in use.

| Frame id | Axes (summary) | Typical use | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **ADR-0041 mocap world** | x → target, y **up**, z → golfer's **right** | Pinhole reconstruction, camera rig | [`cameras.py` module doc](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/motion_capture/reconstruct/cameras.py#L1-L8) |
| **Canonical z-up registration** | x → target, y → golfer's **left**, z **up** | Marker YAML, registration import | [`registration.py` `canonical_z_up_to_adr0041_world`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/motion_capture/reference/registration.py#L45-L57) |
| **ISB-style golfer lab** | Built from explicit up/target/handedness | Trunk/pelvis anatomical angles | [`trunk_pelvis.py` header](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/anatomical_angles/trunk_pelvis.py#L1-L10) |
| **Impact parameters (ADR-0041 default)** | Z-up; golfer faces **−X**; target **−Y** | Launch-monitor-style club metrics | [`impact_parameters/__init__.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/impact_parameters/__init__.py#L7-L37) |
| **Ball flight integrator** | Z-up; **+X** forward at azimuth 0; **+Y left** | Trajectory / spin vector | [`flight_models.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/physics/flight_models.py#L228-L248) |

**Camera storage convention:** extrinsics are **`T_world_from_camera`** (not world-from-camera
inversion). OpenCV camera axes: **+z forward, +y down**
([`cameras.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/motion_capture/reconstruct/cameras.py#L3-L8)).
AffineDrift [Motion Capture](../articles/technology-motion-capture.html) discusses
`P = K[R|t]` with world→camera; multiply through the stored direction when fitting UD calibrations.

**Registration map** (canonical z-up → ADR-0041):
`x_w = x_c`, `y_w = z_c`, `z_w = -y_c`
([`registration.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/motion_capture/reference/registration.py#L52-L57)).

## Impact Parameters, Club Path, and Face Signs {#impact-parameters}

Definitions are in
[`impact_parameters/__init__.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/impact_parameters/__init__.py#L7-L37):

- Target basis: **`x_t`** along target, **`z_t`** up, **`y_t = z_t × x_t`** (left of target for a right-handed golfer).
- **Club path** positive = in-to-out; **face angle** positive = open; signs pick up a handedness factor `s = ±1`.
- **Attack angle** negative when descending.
- **Swing plane** fit uses face-centre samples within **±20 ms** of impact; **impact state** is last pre-contact sample.

Compare carefully with AffineDrift articles that declare y-up target frames or path positive **right**
(for example [Impact Mechanics](../articles/impact-mechanics-and-ball-flight.html) and
[Launch Monitor Vendor Reference](../articles/launch-monitor-vendor-reference.html)).

## Ball-Flight Spin and Launch Axes {#ball-flight}

In the unified flight models, spin builds as
`[backspin·sin(az), -backspin·cos(az), sidespin]` with Z-up and **+Y left**
([`flight_models.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/physics/flight_models.py#L239-L248)).
Positive spin-axis tilt can curve the ball **left** relative to that frame—opposite to many
monitor exports that treat positive tilt as **fade/right** unless converted.

## Ground Reaction, Grip Wrench, and Missing Data {#wrenches}

Ground reaction uses force **by the ground on the foot**, Z-up world,
CoP valid only when **`F_z ≥ COP_MIN_FZ_N`**, and **`None`/NaN gaps—not zero—when unavailable**
([`ground_reaction.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/biomechanics/ground_reaction.py#L1-L22)).
Grip wrench summaries use **force by the hand on the club**, reduced to the grip midpoint, with
documented `split_method` when two-hand allocation is indeterminate (manual ch10–11; see biomechanics modules).

## Analytics: Lateral Sign and Dispersion Ellipses {#analytics-signs}

| Tool / module | Horizontal plane convention | "95%" ellipse meaning | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **SG optimizer** `TiltedBivariateGaussian` | Δ⊥ **positive = left** of target (yards) | `confidence_ellipse`: **`a`, `b` are semi-axes** at level *p* (χ²₂ scaling inside) | [`distributions.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/sg_optimizer/shot_model/distributions.py#L28-L36), [§ellipse](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/shared/python/sg_optimizer/shot_model/distributions.py#L88-L98) |
| **Shot pattern analysis** | **`x` downrange, `y` right** (metres) | Empirical/HDR bins in density tools—not the same object as a Gaussian semi-axis | [`dispersion_stats.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/tools/shot_pattern_analysis/dispersion_stats.py#L136-L138) |
| AffineDrift [Shot Pattern Analysis](../articles/shot-pattern-analysis.html) | States lateral **positive right** | Describes binned HDR, not χ² covariance ellipses |

**Conversion cheat sheet:** `y_left = −y_right`; correlation **ρ** changes sign when flipping lateral;
`1 yd = 0.9144 m`. When comparing ellipse **sizes**, check whether a report gives **semi-axes** or **full axis lengths** (factor of two).

## AffineDrift Site vs UpstreamDrift Code {#site-vs-code}

This subsection absorbs the convention bullets tracked in
[#5593](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/5593) at the level of a **single
reference table** (full NOTATION harmonisation remains out of scope here).

| Topic | Common AffineDrift article pattern | UpstreamDrift code default | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| World frame | Mix of Z-up ([NOTATION](notation.html)) and Y-up golf articles (`x` target, `y` up) | Z-up canonical-v2; multiple named frames (table above) | Apply fixed axis permutation per source frame; never assume one global site frame |
| Target / path sign | Several articles: path **right** positive | Impact params: in-to-out positive; SG optimizer: **left** positive lateral | Multiply lateral component by −1 when crossing tables; document handedness |
| Euler pose | [NOTATION.md](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/NOTATION.md#L188-L203) extrinsic Z-Y-X radians | **`canonical-v1` intrinsic XYZ degrees** | Reorder rotation sequence and convert units before Pose Studio import |
| Spatial 6-vectors | Mix of angular-first, linear-first, and force-first wrenches across books | Spatial Jacobian **`[ω; v]`** (angular then linear); **canonical-v2** base **`v`** = **`[linear_world; angular_body]`**; JaxSim [`get_state`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/engines/physics_engines/jaxsim/jaxsim_backend.py#L100-L112) / `velocity_conventions` use **`[angular; linear]`** (differs from canonical-v2 §2); separate wrench policies in biomechanics modules | Permute the object you hold (Jacobian vs v2 `v` vs JaxSim); check power pairing `WᵀV` |
| Gravity magnitude | Often `9.81` in prose | **`9.80665`** m/s² | Use UD constant when reproducing UD numbers |
| Camera extrinsics | Textbook `P=K[R|t]` world→camera | Stored **`T_world_from_camera`** | Invert/transpose per [`cameras.py`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/c8814a1b9d120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15120ce382ee1de9a6583bb5ef569a15/src/motion_capture/reconstruct/cameras.py#L3-L8) |

## Using This Page With Models and Agents {#usage}

1. **Start from `canonical-v2`** when reading dynamics APIs, datasets, or cross-engine conformance tests.
2. **Start from `canonical-v1` / Pose Studio** when importing human-readable pose degrees.
3. **Name the world frame** before comparing impact, mocap, or flight numbers—ADR-0041 impact defaults differ from flight-model axes.
4. **Run conversions at the boundary**; do not assume `get_state()` on a raw engine object is already canonical.

Programming integration context: [UpstreamDrift Educational Integration](../articles/upstreamdrift-educational-integration.html),
[Programming Companion](../models/models.html), and engine pages under `models/models-*.html`.
